pr.title: Construct fixed F101 (7,7) Jacobian transfer and full-domain duals
pr.body:
Constructs an actual fixed F101 isogeny Phi:J(C0)→J(C1) of degree49/type(7,7),with a coordinate evaluator and polarized dual. C0:y²=x⁶+6x⁴+13x²+56;C1:y²=x⁶+26x⁴+42x²+68. Both complete12317-class rational domains pass both signed dual norms[7],bijections and12317 paired-addition cases each direction. All109 original source scalars/nonzero image/source norm[14]/inverse39 and direct coordinates([2]alpha1(P),0) pass. PCC6a1231/5b631f remain unsigned. [pcc:unverified]

The global construction goes beyond rational halving:actual branch-point norms and extension pulls check P1 alpha N0 kills ALL16 geometric J0[2] classes. The finite-etale quotient property factors it through[2];polarized adjoints and torsion-free HOM cancellation give both global norms[7]. All444 old/new elliptic-point extension pulls include origin,U0 and V0 infinity cases. Complete nonzero elliptic2-torsion pullbacks prove embeddings;trace-type uniqueness and j12≠87 give unpolarizedF101-Jacobian nonisomorphism. Full written proof and explicit formal gaps are in SEVEN_TRANSFER.md and crypto:SEVEN_JACOBIAN_PROOF.md. [pcc:unverified]

Reuses unchanged FpR/Kohel,balanced and tower arithmetic. The four gluing models corroborate separately published crypto#3920/sourcecc3229d during the outage;historical Python is not rerun. Our predeclared lexical kernel choice[1,0] gives the68-model,raw scale33,quotient swap and scales21. Two nonsquare-leading direct-monic boundaries are preserved. Native seven-input runtime and separate102/five-input source manifests stay pinned at crypto75a737b8. Earlier independent Montgomery replay validates elliptic kernels/maps,not a second signed verdict for this whole Jacobian map. [pcc:unverified]

Eight new upstream core Lean helpers pass gate8/local bindingPCCb320bb,total80 written project lemmas. They cover ring/group/functional descent and conditional Hom cancellation;actual finite fields,Picard maps,regular quotient morphisms and polarization remain written. Native polynomial IDC records carry exact separately-gated Lean source pointers. Failed toolchain/Clippy/Lean attempts,source snapshots,source-linked report,DOT/SVG and an inspected two-page PDF are retained. [pcc:unverified]

Final local check.sh passes native25/reference57 unit+two integrations,one pre-existing benchmark ignored;all guards,formatting and strict Clippy pass. Main-ledger prefix60 and consumer scoped16-record benchrec gate pass. Exact current head2450815e2a3b84687b405ef8498dae9dc2663fe1 now needs focused GitHub replay;hold merge until that and all actual applicable CI/review requirements complete. No new expensive PR trigger or timeout change. [pcc:unverified]

Next CT21 computes actual49-kernel/64 product4-torsion lifts,transports the old Richelot cross-kernel and builds R1/Psi beyond the accepted six-cycle target. This PR does not claim that continuation implemented. No benchmark,solver/paid allocation,novelty,cross-prime transfer or computational advantage. S3/live-budget,crypto frozen-ledger/archive and KB/vault blockers remain separate open work. [pcc:unverified]
